metadata.title: Clicked like I’m allergic to shooting and accidentally got a 1 kill?! Valorant aim lost it again
metadata.description:
Me: spazzing like I forgot where the shoot button lives

If your aim’s a lovable disaster, this one’s for you

Tap if your aim cheats like mine!
